description: Save a design you made in Claude (desktop, Claude Code, the BAMF plugin) onto a post together with its HTML source, so it can be edited and animated with Claude inside BAMF. Upload a bamf-design-source/v1 zip as base64: index.html (one image) or slide-01.html, slide-02.html... (carousel), every local file under assets/, and manifest.json {format:"bamf-design-source/v1", made_with:"claude_code", entries, width, height, scale}. BAMF stores it privately, renders it at width x height x scale and adds it as a new version marked Made with Claude and for review. Max 12 MB. Never schedules or publishes. Poll bamf.get_design.

note.description: Optional one-line change note shown with the version.

name: bamf.save_design_source
